title: The Wind in the Willow

vibeProfile.oneLine: Mole, Rat, Badger and the incorrigible Toad, at home on the river.

summary: On a gentle English riverbank, the shy Mole, the genial Rat, the wise Badger and the incorrigible, motorcar-mad Toad muddle through adventures, escapades and the deep pleasures of home and friendship. Kenneth Grahame's classic is two books in one: a riotous comedy of Toad's misdeeds, and a quieter, almost mystical hymn to the countryside and the comfort of good companions. Beloved for over a century, it is one of the coziest and most re-readable books ever written.
whyReadIt: The coziest book on the shelf. Messing about in boats, a bombastic Toad, and the deep pleasure of home and friends.

funFacts.text: It began as bedtime stories Grahame told his young son.
